import { merge } from 'es-toolkit';

- `merge` comes from the main `es-toolkit` export. It matches lodash on all in-range inputs.
- `startCase` must come from `es-toolkit/compat`. The main-export version lowercases the rest of each word, so it diverges from lodash on uppercase runs like `ABC`, which the input range allows.
- `isEmpty` exists only in `es-toolkit/compat`. The main export has no equivalent, and the compat version matches lodash on numbers and booleans, which count as empty.
